senior-content-writer.title: Content Writer
senior-content-writer.short: Centro is seeking a talented and culturally savvy Senior Content Writer to join our Marketing & Communications team. Reporting to the Marketing Manager, you will create engaging, SEO-optimized content tailored to the Gulf, KSA, and USA markets. Your expertise in regional nuances and digital content trends will help drive brand awareness and support business growth across diverse audiences. The ideal candidate is a skilled storyteller with a deep understanding of SEO, content strategy, and cross-cultural communication, capable of producing high-quality content that resonates with international B2B and B2C audiences.
senior-content-writer.full:
Department: Marketing & Communications Department

Reports To: Marketing Manager

Senior Content Writer

Key Responsibilities:

  • Research, write, and edit SEO-optimized, region-specific content for blogs and website pages, ensuring cultural relevance and engagement.
  • Develop thought leadership articles, industry insights, and B2B/B2C content aligned with business trends in the Gulf, KSA, and USA markets.
  • Optimize content for search engines (Google, Blogs, Clusters) and voice search trends, ensuring high rankings and visibility.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to craft compelling website copy, enhancing user experience and conversion rates.
  • Adapt writing style to fit regional audience preferences, considering linguistic nuances, formal vs. conversational tones, and culturally relevant storytelling.
  • Stay updated with market trends, government policies (such as Saudi Vision 2030 business strategies), and digital content best practices in these markets.
  • Crafting and managing content strategy for social media calendars, media buying, video scripts, website blogs and social media platforms.

Qualifications:

Fluency in English and Arabic for Gulf, KSA and USA markets.

Proven experience in digital content creation, blog writing, or web copywriting for international audiences.

Strong understanding of content trends, consumer behaviour, and regional sensitivities in the Gulf, KSA, and USA.

Expertise in SEO strategies, keyword research, and on-page optimization.

Experience with CMS platforms (WordPress, HubSpot, etc.) and content management tools.

Ability to adapt tone, style, and messaging to different business sectors and regional audiences.

project-manager.title: Project Manager
project-manager.short: Centro is seeking an experienced and proactive Project Manager (PMP-certified) to lead and deliver high-impact projects in the Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) sector. Reporting to the Head of PM, you will oversee project lifecycles from planning to execution, ensuring alignment with business objectives, driving process improvements, and maintaining compliance standards. The ideal candidate is a dynamic leader with a track record of managing complex projects, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and optimizing operational efficiency in a fast-paced environment.
project-manager.full:
Department: Project Management
Reports To: Head of PM

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Project Manager (PMP-certified) with experience in the Business Process Outsourcing industry to lead, manage, and execute projects effectively. The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing project lifecycles, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and driving process improvements while maintaining quality and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Planning & Execution:

  • Develop and execute project plans, timelines, and deliverables aligned with business goals
  • Define project scope, objectives, and resource requirements
  • Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure successful project completion

Stakeholder Management:

  • Collaborate with internal teams, clients, and vendors to ensure seamless project execution
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project updates, escalations, and reporting
  • Manage expectations and ensure alignment between stakeholders and project goals

Process Improvement & Compliance:

  • Drive operational efficiency by implementing process improvements in BPO workflows
  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations, company policies, and quality standards
  • Utilize data analytics and KPIs to measure project success and identify areas for optimization
  • Allocate and optimize resources effectively to meet project deadlines

Reporting & Documentation:

  • Maintain detailed project documentation, including reports, dashboards, and meeting minutes
  • Present project updates to senior management, highlighting key milestones and challenges
  • Ensure all project records are updated and stored as per company policies

Qualifications & Skills:

  • PMP Certification (Project Management Professional) – Required
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, or a related field
  • Experience in the BPO industry (minimum 5+ years in project management)
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall)
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and negotiation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency in project management tools
  • Data-driven mindset with expertise in reporting and analytics

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience managing transitions, migrations, or new client onboarding in BPO
  • Strong understanding of BPO KPIs, SLAs, and operational excellence frameworks
  • Six Sigma or Lean Certification is a plus

talent-acquisition-specialist.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
talent-acquisition-specialist.short: Centro is seeking a proactive and resourceful Talent Acquisition Specialist to support our growing recruitment needs. You will play a key role in identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent across various departments, with a focus on delivering a seamless and professional candidate experience. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, tech-savvy, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
talent-acquisition-specialist.full:
Department: Talent Acquisition
Reports to: Talent Management Head
Employment Type: Full-Time

Key Responsibilities

• Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for assigned roles, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating offers.

• Collaborate with hiring managers to understand role requirements and develop effective sourcing strategies.

• Maintain job postings across multiple platforms (LinkedIn, Wuzzuf, etc.) and ensure accurate, appealing job descriptions.

• Use ATS and CRM systems to manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely follow up and status updates.

• Conduct initial HR interviews and assess candidates for cultural and role fit.

• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers, ensuring clear communication with all parties.

• Prepare and send offers and support onboarding coordination when needed.

• Maintain accurate recruitment data, reports, and documentation for internal audits and HR tracking.

Qualifications & Skills

• 1–3 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition, preferably in BPO, tech, or service-based industries.

• Hands-on experience with ATS/HRIS tools (e.g., BambooHR, Workable, Odoo, etc.).

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both in Arabic and English.

• Ability to manage multiple roles simultaneously and prioritize effectively.

• Familiarity with behavioral and competency-based interviewing techniques.

• A positive, can-do attitude with a focus on collaboration and continuous improvement.

gl-accountant.title: GL Accountant
gl-accountant.short: Centro is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive GL Accountant to join our Finance team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger, supporting month-end and year-end close processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate financial reporting and compliance. The ideal candidate has a strong accounting background, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
gl-accountant.full:
Department: Finance
Reports To: Financial Controller


Job Overview:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive GL Accountant to join our dynamic finance team at Centro. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the integrity of the company’s general ledger, ensuring accurate and timely recording of financial transactions, and assisting with month-end and year-end close processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to support accurate financial reporting and compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

General Ledger Management:

  • Maintain and reconcile the general ledger, ensuring that all transactions are accurately recorded.
  • Process journal entries for various accounting functions (e.g., accruals, prepaids, fixed assets).
  • Ensure proper allocation of expenses and revenue according to company policies and accounting standards.

Month-End and Year-End Close:

  • Support the timely and accurate closing of monthly and annual financials, ensuring compliance with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Prepare and review supporting schedules for month-end close, including balance sheet reconciliations and profit & loss statements.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies during the close process.

Financial Reporting & Reconciliation:

  • Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations and ensure all reconciling items are identified and resolved.
  • Assist with the preparation of financial statements and internal reports, ensuring they align with accounting standards (GAAP or IFRS, depending on the company’s jurisdiction).
  • Work closely with other accounting teams to ensure accurate reporting of financial data.

Compliance & Internal Controls:

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls and financial reporting standards.
  • Assist with the implementation and maintenance of accounting policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Support external audits by providing necessary documentation and explanations as required.

Accounts Payable & Receivable Support:

  • Support the AP and AR teams to ensure that transactions are recorded in the general ledger accurately.
  • Assist in resolving discrepancies between the general ledger and subsidiary ledgers.

Ad-hoc Projects & Process Improvements:

  • Assist in various ad-hoc accounting projects or analysis as needed.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to streamline and automate processes to improve accuracy and efficiency.

Key Qualifications:

  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in General Ledger accounting, preferably within a technology or service-based industry.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (CPA or similar certifications are a plus).

Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of general ledger functions, journal entries, and reconciliation processes.
  • Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, etc.).
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data analysis).
  • Understanding of accounting standards (GAAP or IFRS).
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.

Knowledge:

  • Understanding of financial statements (balance sheet, P&L, and cash flow).
  • Familiarity with tax compliance and regulatory requirements in the tech services industry.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines with competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with automated accounting systems or ERP systems (MS Dynamics, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle).
  • Previous experience in a fast-paced environment, such as a tech services company.
  • Knowledge of multi-currency accounting (if relevant).
  • Ability to communicate complex financial data to non-financial stakeholders

business-development-representative-bdr.title: BD Representative
business-development-representative-bdr.short: Centro is seeking a motivated and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Sales & Business Development team. Reporting to the SDR/BDR Team Lead, you will play a key role in generating and qualifying leads within the healthcare sector, targeting larger organizations and high-volume practices. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in B2B outreach, excels in building relationships with senior decision-makers, and is driven to meet and exceed monthly performance targets.
business-development-representative-bdr.full:
Department: Sales & Business Development
Reports to: SDR/BDR Team Lead
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for prospecting and qualifying leads, focusing on larger healthcare organizations, multi-location practices, and high-volume clinics. The BDR engages with decision-makers, nurtures relationships, and sets up high-value demo meetings for Sales Executives. The role requires strategic outreach, persistence, and a consultative approach to drive opportunities forward.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead Generation & Qualification

  • Work with assigned leads from the dialer/CRM while also generating new leads online (LinkedIn, social media, healthcare databases, and industry networks).
  • Target larger organizations, including hospital groups, multi-location practices, and high-volume clinics.
  • Identify and engage with key decision-makers (C-suite executives, Physicians Owner, practice administrators, or senior medical staff).
  • Conduct thorough research on target organizations to personalize outreach.
  • Communicate the value of RPM & CCM in a compelling and tailored manner.

Sales Engagement & Demo Scheduling

  • Schedule high-value demo meetings for Sales Executives.
  • Build relationships through multi-touch outreach (calls, emails, LinkedIn messaging).
  • Manage complex sales cycles, ensuring long-term engagement with potential clients.
  • Overcome objections and address key concerns to maintain prospect interest.

Pipeline Management & Performance Targets

  • Achieve a minimum of 10 attended demos per month.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records for all interactions.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales Executives to ensure a smooth handoff and proper follow-up.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in healthcare or SaaS).
  • Proven ability to engage with senior decision-makers and navigate complex sales cycles.
  • Strong research, communication, and consultative selling skills.
  • Experience using CRM systems, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other prospective tools.
  • Self-driven, highly organized, and able to manage a large pipeline of leads.

data-entry-specialist.title: BD Representative
data-entry-specialist.short: Centro is looking for a dynamic and driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Staff Augmentation and ITO Sales team. Reporting to the Business Development Manager, you will play a vital role in generating and qualifying leads, laying the groundwork for the sales process. Your efforts will directly impact the company’s growth by identifying new business opportunities, conducting in-depth prospect research, and scheduling discovery calls for Account Executives. This is an exciting opportunity to grow your career in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and help connect top clients with innovative ITO services.
data-entry-specialist.full:
Department: Staff Augmentation and ITO Sales
Reports To: Business Development Manager

Role Overview

The Business Development Representative (BDR) plays a critical role in the sales process by identifying and qualifying new business opportunities. The BDR focuses on the top of the sales funnel, generating leads and nurturing them to the qualification stage, where they can be handed over to Account Executives (AEs) for further development and closure.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Lead Generation & Prospecting
    • Use LinkedIn, email marketing, online resources, and cold calling to identify potential clients.
    • Research target accounts, industries, and key decision-makers to build a prospect database.
    • Execute outreach campaigns to engage potential clients, leveraging tools like Zoho CRM and email automation.
  2. Qualification
    • Conduct initial conversations to understand prospects’ business needs, pain points, and potential fit for ITO services.
    • Use a structured framework to qualify leads based on predefined criteria (budget, authority, need, and timing – BANT).
    • Schedule discovery calls for qualified leads with Account Executives.
  3. Pipeline Management
    • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all interactions in Zoho CRM.
    • Track and report on KPIs such as outreach activities, lead qualification rates, and pipeline contribution.
  4. Collaboration
    • Work closely with marketing to align outreach efforts with ongoing campaigns.
    • Provide feedback on lead quality and market trends to refine the sales process.
    • Collaborate with AEs to ensure smooth handoffs of qualified leads.

Qualifications

Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

1-3 years of experience in a similar sales or lead generation role.

Proficiency in LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zoho CRM, and email marketing tools.

Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
